subject: Request: Short eval lifeline while PO is under review
messages:
From: Nicole Yang <nicole.yang@mediwave.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Short eval lifeline while PO is under review

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the console analytics. We started the procurement funnel this morning but legal flagged a couple of contract points and put the PO on hold for review. Procurement expects the review to finish by next Tuesday (7/7), but the current sandbox tokens will run out in ~72 hours.

Is there any possibility Redwood can provision a short lifeline (either a small token credit or a 7–10 day trial extension) so we can keep the evaluation running? If helpful, I can share the draft PO and the redlines — legal is being conservative but we don’t anticipate major blockers. Our success manager (Tom Alvarez) is on copy.

We’re very close to a pilot commitment and don’t want momentum lost while paperwork moves. Appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Nicole Yang
Head of Clinical Informatics
MediWave Health
attachments: MediWave_PO_pending.pdf (partial PO, redacted)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Yang <nicole.yang@mediwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T11:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Short eval lifeline while PO is under review

Hi Nicole —

Really glad the demo landed well. Thanks for the context and for sending the partial PO. Totally understandable — procurement/legal cycles can take a bit.

We can help keep things moving: I can approve a short eval lifeline today consisting of a 10k token promo credit and a 7-day extension on your sandbox access so your engineers and clinical leads can continue testing. If you need a longer runway, let me know what length you expect procurement to need and we can discuss.

Ben, I’ve looped you in to handle the promo provisioning and any billing questions. Marissa, could you keep an eye on onboarding so Nicole’s team stays unblocked?

Nicole — if you’re OK with that plan I’ll ask Ben to provision the credit and I’ll confirm once it’s live.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Yang <nicole.yang@mediwave.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Short eval lifeline while PO is under review

Hi Nicole —

Nice to meet you (virtually). Olga — thanks for flagging.

Nicole, we’ll set up a promo code / internal credit named "eval_lifeline_MEDIWAVE" for 10,000 tokens and extend sandbox access by 7 days starting when you confirm. I just need a billing contact and the partial PO you referenced so we can log the deal and attach the PO to the HubSpot record. The legal redlines you sent look straightforward from our side — included a copy of our latest standard terms in case you want to compare (terms_redline_v2.pdf).

Next steps to get this live:
- Nicole: confirm you accept the 10k token credit + 7-day extension
- Send billing contact and any PO reference number
- We'll provision the credit and reply here when active

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: terms_redline_v2.pdf
From: Nicole Yang <nicole.yang@mediwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@mediwave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T16:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Short eval lifeline while PO is under review

Ben / Olga —

Thanks, that sounds great and we appreciate the quick help. We confirm acceptance of the 10k token credit and 7-day extension. Billing contact is: Sarah Kim (sarah.kim@mediwave.com), Procurement ref: MW-PO-2026-045 (this is the draft reference while legal finalizes). I've attached the partial PO we shared with legal earlier (MediWave_PO_pending.pdf).

If you can provision the credit today, that would keep our engineers running through the weekend while legal finishes up. We expect to have the signed PO to you by 7/7 at the latest.

Thanks again — charitable move. Looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Nicole Yang
Head of Clinical Informatics
MediWave Health
